# Latent Lens

> Latent Lens is a B2B AI evaluation and quality intelligence platform. It tests LLM applications, RAG pipelines and AI agents for factual accuracy, hallucinations and instruction adherence, and returns a scored report with a failure taxonomy and remediation steps.

## Product
- [Free AI Response Checker](https://ricardojose000.github.io/latent-lens/checker.html): submit a prompt, an AI response and optional ground truth; get faithfulness, hallucination rate, instruction adherence and relevance scores.
- [Sample report](https://ricardojose000.github.io/latent-lens/#report): an illustrative evaluation of a customer-support RAG answer.

## How evaluation works
- Responses are decomposed into atomic claims and grounded against the supplied context.
- Instructions (length, format, language, exclusions, required items) are extracted from the prompt and verified one by one.
- Judges only assign labels through a strict JSON schema; scores are computed in code, so runs are reproducible.

## Services
- [Quality audits and custom pilots](https://ricardojose000.github.io/latent-lens/#pilot)
